reason: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that delegates text processing, image analysis, OCR, and image comparison to a locally managed KoboldCpp server.

summaries.zh: 将文本处理、图像分析、OCR 和图像比较任务委托给本地 KoboldCpp 服务的 DeepSeek Harness 工具插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that delegates text processing, image analysis, OCR, and image comparison to a locally managed KoboldCpp server.

capabilities: Spawns and manages a local KoboldCpp process
Sends text prompts and images to a local model server
Fetches images from data or HTTP(S) URLs
Registers text and vision tools with the harness
